user.title: Referenzmarktwert PV
user.description: Calculates the Austrian reference market value (§ 13 EAG) from Energy-Charts data (CC BY 4.0) and E-Control's official values. The data sources are preset; open the section only to change them.

data_description.deduction: Subtracted from the market value for the payout sensors (Hofer Sonne: 0.015 EUR/kWh).

data_description.energy_charts_url: Base URL of the Energy-Charts API.
data_description.generation_path: Endpoint for generation data, relative to the API URL.
data_description.price_path: Endpoint for day-ahead prices, relative to the API URL.
data_description.country: Energy-Charts country code for the generation data, e.g. at.
data_description.bidding_zone: Energy-Charts bidding zone for the prices, e.g. AT.
data_description.production_type: Name of the generation type in the Energy-Charts data, e.g. Solar.
data_description.header_name: Optional, e.g. for an API key. Sent with every Energy-Charts request.
data_description.econtrol_url: URL of E-Control's history file of the official values (xlsx).
data_description.econtrol_month_column: Column of the month in the E-Control file.
data_description.econtrol_value_column: Column of the technology's value (D = photovoltaics).
data_description.econtrol_base_column: Column of the day-ahead base price (for the estimate). Empty: not used.
data_description.time_zone: Months are counted in this time zone.
